nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Purifying Foaming Face Wash for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Many reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and makeup without over-drying, though a few say it can leave skin feeling stripped or dry.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry, or note it turned dry after use, generally report the product is too drying for them.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oily T-zone areas while keeping cheeks from feeling tight or dry, though one reviewer with combo/oily skin found it too drying and irritating on the cheeks.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and a gentle, non-stripping cleanse, but a small number describe burning, itching, eyelid eczema-like flare-ups, or cystic breakouts.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers in their 30s-59s with mature or aging combination skin report it keeps skin clean and balanced without dryness, and one mentions it seemed to help with fine lines.

concerns.aging: One reviewer felt the cleanser helped with aging lines alongside hydration, but this is mentioned only once and not a common theme.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the wash cleans without leaving skin feeling tight, stripped, or dry, often noting they skip a hydrating toner; however, several others explicitly call it very drying, including on combination and even oily skin.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin after breakouts cleared, but one reviewer with combination skin experienced painful redness and burning after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state it cleans without disrupting the skin barrier; one reviewer, however, believes it damaged her skin barrier, causing burning and pain.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers mention fading dark spots or discoloration with continued use, though this is not widely reported.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal-acne skin report reduced breakouts and clearer skin over weeks of use; a few, however, describe worsening cystic pimples or scarring.
concerns.oiliness: Numerous oily-skin reviewers report it controls surface oil throughout the day without a greasy feel, with no dissent on this point.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser rusts or grows mold

extraits.texte: This product made me break out with cystic pimples all over my face. I gave it a few months to see if my skin just needed to get used to it..nope it got worse. My face is still recovering from the scars it left. I also wouldn't recommend the toleraine lotion because it made my skin itch like crazy. if you're thinking of trying any of those please do a patch test.

extraits.titre: Maybe good for oily skin but not good for combo skin...
extraits.texte: So i have combo skin that is rly oily in my t zone and blackheads on my nose, and i thought this cleanser would help. but i guess maybe i shouldn't use it on my cheeks or smthg because after using it am pm for three days my skin was red and really painful. I think it was really dry so I applied a heavy moisturizer but my skin was BURNING! Maybe I should only use it on my t zone but to be honest I didn't really see any results. And it said safe for sensitive skin, but I think it ruined my skin barrier? I don't really write any reviews but i just wanted to say if you have sensitive or combo skin or just dry skin don't try this product. but i rated a 3/5 because i feel like oily skinned people might thrive with this cleanser and the packaging is nice, but just not for me

I have hyper sensitive skin ( think newborn baby but worse ) i have wanted to try this brand for years but was extremely lery of it . I normally use korean brands , but it seemed like my skin was telling me to use something els as i had breakouts galore. Decided to give this a try and so glad i did , after 4 days of use i was surprised as my breakouts are almost completely gone . This has not broken me out or made my face red . Will definitely be buying more

I have combination skin with it being oily in the T zone and the rest of my face is normal, this face wash helped balance my skin without making it feel tight/dry and a little bit goes a long way and it foams nicely. I would purchase again!

Gets rid of the oily skin feeling that I deal with a lot of the day but does not replace it with a dried-out, stretched feeling. I like this a lot and have had zero pimples or zits since starting to use it. I started using this in May and it's now the end of June. I'm very impressed. I first tried this by using a sample I got at a yearly derm doc appointment.

I've tried other foam cleansers and I always go back to this one. I'm on my third bottle and honestly, I really enjoy most of La Roche-Posay products, they leave my skin feeling so clean. This foam cleanser can leave your skin feeling a bit dry but I always go in with a hydrating toner after cleansing and love how my skin looks and feels after.
I have sensitice, fair, and acne prone skin. This does an amazing job at actuslly cleaning my face and not clogging my pores! Well worth the money!
